notes: C8 = C7 (c7Reference) + crates/turso_persistence (Convex persistence on turso_core 0.8.1, same db.sqlite3 file, WAL, one writer with commit/retention lanes + reader pool that keeps one reader for point lookups, index scan without correlated subquery, gated WAL maintenance, SQLite recovers a crash WAL before Turso opens), CONVEX_SQLITE_ENGINE=rusqlite|turso (default rusqlite); crates_vendor/turso_core = turso_core 0.8.1 with page-cache invalidation by page instead of a full clear on every change (snapshots/turso_core-0.8.1-granular-cache.patch in the evidence folder), wired with [patch.crates-io]; isolate: a read syscall batch runs holding the concurrency permit and heap stats refresh every 16 turns; local_backend: jemalloc global allocator with background_thread, graceful SIGTERM; db_connection: with the turso engine, the default query concurrency is 2 x CPUs (4..16) unless APPLICATION_MAX_CONCURRENT_QUERIES is set; common: INDEX_CACHE_VERIFY_PERCENT defaults to 1 instead of 100 (a 1% sample of index cache hits is still read again from persistence and panics on a mismatch; at 100 the cache saved no reads); cmd_util: Sentry layer filtered at INFO. isolate: ready contexts (isolate/src/warm_snapshot.rs, AMAGE_WARM_SNAPSHOT, default on): after a query or mutation module is imported in a fresh context, its graph is built into a V8 snapshot by the backend binary started again as a child (AMAGE_WARM_SNAPSHOT_BUILD_DIR), so a V8 abort on an unserializable import only drops that module; the import runs under a probe that refuses every op and syscall except textEncoder/normalizeLabel, pending promise reactions and unhandled rejections; the child starts from the parent's runtime snapshot with --no-extensible-ro-snapshot so every blob keeps its read-only part (V8 shares one read-only heap per process); later requests on the same source package deserialize the ready context and register its modules instead of importing them; isolates move to a new blob generation at their next request. Built on magodohayday from /srv/amage-c8/c8k-src, a copy of this tree, and accepted there on sqlite, postgres and turso. Local image, never pushed.
